name: Coronal Mass Ejection (Solar Storm)
description: An intense solar flare releases energetic relativistic protons across the interplanetary trajectory.
impact: Solar array photo-voltaic cells sustain 8% permanent lattice degradation; avionics shielded.

name: Deep Space Network (DSN) Ground Station Dropout
description: Severe weather at Goldstone tracking station temporarily interrupts telemetry downlink pass.
impact: Downlink suspended for 36 hours; solid-state recorder buffer prevented science data loss.

name: Solar Array Drive Mechanism Stiction & Dust Accumulation
description: Drive motor encounters mechanical resistance reducing optimal sun-tracking pointing accuracy.
impact: Effective power generation reduced by 25 Watts until thermal cycling resolved pointing.

name: Optical Imager Cryocooler Thermal Anomaly
description: Sensor detector focal plane array temperature elevated above cryogenic calibration threshold.
impact: Autonomous flight software initiated automated sensor bakeout cycle for 5 days.

name: Breakthrough Subsurface Volatile Water Ice Detection
description: Orbital radar sounding echo returns definitive signature of buried pure water-ice glacier.
impact: Major scientific milestone achieved! Mission science yield awarded bonus peer-review priority.

name: Upper Atmospheric Drag Transient
description: Solar atmospheric heating expands thermosphere density, causing minor orbital periapsis altitude decay.
impact: Spacecraft executed an automated 6 m/s orbital re-boost burn consuming 5 kg of fuel.

name: Attitude Star Tracker Straylight Glare
description: Scattered solar reflections off thermal blankets temporarily blind primary star sensor cameras.
impact: Attitude determination handed over to gyroscopic inertial measurement units seamlessly.
